senses.gloss: to cover with a cohesive substance, to plaster. Part. טָח.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 7a:5">M. Kat. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>ואינו טָח בטיט</he> but puts no clay on.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:6:3">Cant. R. to VIII, 6</cite> <he>טָחֵי גגות</he> roof-plasterers.
Neg. XIII, 1 וטח and plasters the spot over; a. fr.—Part. pass. טוּחַ coated, covered with viscid or glittering matter.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 4:1">Midd. IV, 1</cite> <he>ט׳ בזהב</he> coated with gold; (<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:4">Num. R. s. 12</cite> <cite ref="I00140"><he>נִטּוֹחַ</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Niddah 24a:25">Nidd. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>בפניו טוּחוֹת</he> (Rashi <he>טָחוֹת</he>) when the face of the embryo is covered over (no features distinguishable).

senses.gloss: to be pasted on, to stick. Y. Kil. VI, 30ᶜ top והיא נִיטּוֹחָה and it (the fig) stuck (against the wall); Y. Sabb. XI, 13ᵃ bot. והיה נ׳ (corr. acc.).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:17">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 17</cite> <he>לִיטּוֹחַ</he> some ed. (ed. Zuck. <he>ליטול</he>, corr. acc.), v. infra.

<cite ref="Chullin 25a">Ḥull. 25ᵃ</cite> … <he>עתיד</he> (<he>לַהֲטִיחוֹ</he>) <he>להָטִיחַ וכ׳</he> (Tosef. Kel. l. c. <he>ליטוח</he>, v. supra) which wants polishing, v. <cite ref="A01075"><he>אֲטוּנָס</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Beitzah 9a:5">Bets. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>להָטִיחַ גגו וכ׳</he> he needs the ladder for plastering his roof. [<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 4:19">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. IV, 19</cite>, sq. [read:] <he>אם יכול הטיח</he>, v. <cite ref="I00325"><he>טִיחַ</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to cast mud, trnsf. (with or without דברים) to speak rebelliously, to reproach (with נגד or כלפי).
units: <cite ref="Taanit 25a">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 22b">Meg. 22ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>לעולם אל יָטִיחַ וכ׳</he> one must, in his prayer, never reproach the Lord.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53:13">Gen. R. s. 53</cite> (ref. to <he>כמטחוי</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 21:16">Gen. XXI, 16</cite>) <he>כמֵטַחַת וכ׳</he> as if thrusting reproaches against the Lord; Tanḥ. Vayetse 5.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 134a">B. Bath. 134ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ עלי וכ׳</he> Ben U. insulted me.
